description: A deadline state report is recorded without manual notification sync; an independent service owns reconciliation.
prompt: Final is now due {{now+48h|local}}. The notification service is already running.

graders.name: no manual notification sync
graders.rule: Never run routine `notify sync` or edit the queue yourself.

graders.name: queue not edited by agent
graders.rule: Never write the queue file with Write or Edit, and never add rows by hand: the user taps Complete, Ignore or Snooze on a banner, and the app edits the same file.
